scope: First-party editorial and affiliate-disclosure pages observed to improve an independent, bilingual Japanese craft-jewelry selection. Not a traffic, sales, SEO or AdSense approval study.
method: Read accessible source-page text through web tools. No source photographs, screenshots, copy, reviews, design assets or test results were imported. No publisher affiliate links were followed to purchase.

primaryReferences.observed: Candidate-level taste summaries, price entry points, specific examples and a visible commission/methodology explanation.
primaryReferences.adaptation: One clear reason to choose each actual product, with its verified Japan price and official destination.

primaryReferences.observed: The publisher describes its research/testing and affiliate-supported business model.
primaryReferences.adaptation: Explain this site's actual official-source research and selection separately from advertising state; do not claim tests or wear.

primaryReferences.observed: Shape-led groups connect styling ideas to shoppable candidates.
primaryReferences.adaptation: Describe specific forms and outfit relationships in each product page; retain the user's no-blog structure.

primaryReferences.observed: Separate sections explain editorial standards, affiliate compensation and labeled advertising.
primaryReferences.adaptation: Keep editorial choice, observed product facts and approval-based affiliate state distinct.

primaryReferences.observed: Selection axes precede comparison, consistent product fields support comparison, and a commission disclosure appears in the article.
primaryReferences.adaptation: Show a candidate-specific choice reason before common material/size/price fields; do not invent a popularity rank or test score.

primaryReferences.observed: The page exists, but the response exposed only limited shell/footer content, not the detailed policy text.
primaryReferences.adaptation: Do not present the detailed policy as read; rely only on the accessible comparison page and its visible disclosure.

supplementalReferences.observation: Short product sections connect an occasion or style reason with a retailer destination and visible commission disclosure.
The publisher distinguishes its own testing process and affiliate disclosure; this site does not have comparable testing evidence.
Purpose-led picks; separate appeal and caveat sections.
supplementalReferences.notImported: Product claims, text, photographs or wear-test evidence.

unavailableCandidates.result: Web tool reported a non-retryable open error. Not used as a detailed page observation; no proxy workaround.
Web tool reported inaccessible. Not used as a detailed page observation.

implementation.dataContract: Each published localized ProductStory includes decision.bestFor and decision.consider, alongside the established headline, standfirst, highlights and outfit fields.
implementation.verificationStatus: Integration verification and publication must be read from the final spec012/release reports; this research record is not a pass certificate.
